recommendations.title: Upgrade the GitHub PAT to include webhooks:write on MadeAt2AM
recommendations.reason: This is the linchpin for today's biggest win. The full pipeline works — local folder → private repo → webhook → redeploy → live URL — but every new repo needs manual webhook setup until the PAT has webhooks:write. Without it, every project becomes a 5-minute manual step that interrupts the flow the pipeline was built to remove. baymax-pipeline-probe.terrybot.top is live but won't auto-redeploy on push. The fix is 30 seconds on github.com/settings/tokens (edit token, add 'Webhooks: Read+Write' on MadeAt2AM org) — but it needs you, not me.
recommendations.action: Open https://github.com/settings/tokens, edit your fine-grained token, add 'Webhooks: Read+Write' permission scoped to the MadeAt2AM organization. Save. Next time I run `project.sh new <anything>`, the webhook auto-registers and the pipeline is truly hands-off. While you're there, also consider adding 'Administration: Read+Write' for repo creation if not already present. Total time: under 1 minute.
